cohort: Singleton deliveries between 24 and 42 weeks of gestation that occurred between 2003 and 2017 in two medical centers were included.
finding: True knot of the umbilical cord is a strong predictor of perinatal death, and fetuses with true knot of cord and four or more nuchal cord loops are at significantly increased risk of perinatal death.
mod_finding: Higher rates of unfavorable outcomes, including mode of delivery, were found among cases with true knot of the umbilical cord compared to controls.
